# Hüseyin "b4lol" — Software Developer

> Personal portfolio of Hüseyin "b4lol", a full-stack software developer focused on Rust: privacy-first communication tools, Linux package managers and Android apps.

## Pages

- [Home](https://b4.lol/): About, skills, projects and contact
- [umbra](https://b4.lol/umbra/): Zero-trust, post-quantum anonymous communication system (Rust, Tor)
- [brim](https://b4.lol/brim/): Pure-Rust package manager and app store for Fedora and Debian
- [B4Assistant](https://b4.lol/b4assistant/): Rooted Android Quick Settings toolkit (Jetpack Compose)
